stills.prompt: Extreme close-up of the flywheel of the left engine in @engine, the worn original: its black iron five-spoke flywheel fills most of the frame, seen from the same low front three-quarter angle, with the brass crank and the edge of the upright aged-gold (#C6A94F) brass cylinder just visible at the left of frame. Same engine, same design, same worn brass with faint fingerprints and a thin oil sheen. The bronze copy is out of frame to the right. Low-key interior: near-black stone workshop with almost no ambient light. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes from high left and draws a crisp edge along the rim and spokes; everything else falls into black. No lamps, no windows, no people, no lettering. Photorealistic, natural film grain.
